def longestIncreasingSubsequence (nums : List Int) (h_precond : longestIncreasingSubsequence_precond nums) : Nat :=
  match nums with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs =>
      let rec helper (rest : List Int) (currentLen : Nat) : Nat :=
        match rest with
        | [] => currentLen
        | y :: ys =>
            if y > x then
              helper ys (currentLen + 1)
            else
              helper ys currentLen
      helper xs 1
